article.story: RIVERSIDE, Calif. -- — Dominique Daniels Jr. scored 30 points as California Baptist beat Southern 75-67 on Tuesday night. Daniels also contributed six rebounds and six assists for the Lancers (9-3). Thomas Ndong scored 11 points and grabbed 11 rebounds. Martel Williams had 10 points. The Jaguars (4-7) were led by Cam Amboree, who posted 18 points. Malek Abdelgowad added 11 points for Southern. Damariee Jones had 10 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
